shopify.body_html:
Why You'll Love It

Power up your daily health routine with Bournvita Nutritional Health Drink Mix. Specially crafted with essential vitamins and minerals, this delicious chocolate malt mix turns every glass of milk into wholesome vitality.

Nutritional & Taste Highlights

  • 2X Active Nutrients: Enriched with Vitamin D, Iron, and Zinc for bone strength and immunity.
  • Rich Chocolate Malt Taste: Blends instantly with warm or cold milk for smooth indulgence.
  • Automated Food-Grade Hygiene: Certified packaging ensures complete safety and purity.
  • 100% Vegetarian: Wholesome nutrition suitable for the entire family.

Preparation Instructions

Add 2 heaped teaspoons into a cup of hot or cold milk. Stir thoroughly until dissolved. Add sugar if desired and enjoy twice daily.
